question: On s022814's labelled text, which neither human had seen, do blind humans still read rows 24 um inward and 24 um outward of the ink depth?
window: the organizers' s022814 surface volumes of PHerc0841 (2.403 um), SV rows 0-8320 x cols 7644-12521 (20.0 x 11.7 mm); labelled ink 0.205 cm2; its labels overlap w00's at Dice 0.028 (different writing); labels define the depth origin only
reader: canonical 2.4 um ink model, 62-layer input window (~149 um), inked order forward; a* = argmax label AUC = +0
sign: on the organizers' surface volumes raw +o (layers) = inward; in24 = a* + 10, out24 = a* - 10, in48 = a* + 20, out48 = a* - 20

arms.ctrl: readable control: the organizers' s022814 surface at the label-defined ink depth a* (= +0 layers here)
arms.in24: the whole surface shifted uniformly 10 layers (24.0 um) inward
arms.out24: the whole surface shifted uniformly 10 layers (24.0 um) outward
arms.in48: edge arm, descriptive: 20 layers (48.1 um) inward (no blank)
arms.out48: edge arm, descriptive: 20 layers (48.1 um) outward (no blank)
arms.w10_top: top 10 x 10 mm window of the control map (12.5 um per tile pixel; rated after the same text at 20 mm, so primed)
arms.w10_bot: bottom 10 x 10 mm window of the control map (primed)

pictures.guards: every partsheet_tolerance surface picture that this rater had called not rows blind (count per rater: see the page facts)
pictures.calib: calibration: a known-rows ink map of another public fragment's known text (not this window), a picture both raters had rated before
pictures.calib_blank: the calibration map in the wrong layer order (wrong-order blank)

dropped: the 9.6 um reader pair (H9) was dropped by the pre-written alignment rule (cross-correlation peak shift [-8, -10] 4-px blocks, about 77 / 96 um, against a 3-block / 29 um bar): reader line unanswered

rule.valid_rater: every picture answered; calibration rows; <= 1 of the surface blanks (ctrl, in24, out24, 10 mm) rows; >= 1 guard on the page; else VOID. A level counts only if its own blank is not rows
rule.window: ctrl blank rows -> VOID; WINDOW-YES = ctrl rows; WINDOW-NO = ctrl not rows
rule.depth: an arm whose blank is rows is uncountable -> INCOMPLETE; else WIDE-HOLDS = in24 and out24 rows; NARROW-OUT = in24 rows, out24 not; NARROW-IN = out24 rows, in24 not; NARROW-BOTH = neither
rule.guard: lenient if more than half of the rater's guard pictures are called rows; a lenient WIDE-HOLDS becomes ALL-ROWS
rule.one_cm2: 1CM-READS-PRIMED = both 10 mm windows rows; 20MM-NEEDED = fewer; UNCOUNTABLE if the 10 mm blank is rows (descriptive)

item_verdict.CONFIRMED: WIDE-HOLDS from two valid raters (neither lenient)
item_verdict.NARROWED: NARROW-X: the same NARROW label from two valid raters

scope: uniform shifts of the organizers' surface with this reader only (the +-24 um maps correlate with the unshifted map at r 0.85-0.87); local or dispersed depth error is not covered; the 1 cm2 label is descriptive and primed, never '1 cm2 does not read' (the top 10 mm window holds half the labelled ink and a weaker map); rated after the depth_w results were known
